versions.changelog:
- Initial release of cgis providing deterministic codebase graph queries for structural questions.
- Supports precise tools for finding function callers, analyzing renames, tracing execution paths, mapping modules, and detecting architectural drift.
- Subgraph queries optimize context usage compared to manual grepping or full-file reading.
- First-run and update instructions provided for maintaining an up-to-date code graph (`cgis_ingest`).
- Python and TypeScript support included; other languages currently not covered.
- Documentation clarifies the meaning of unresolved edges and static analysis limitations.
